assessment: The source states that 28 microeV is added to the calculated splitting to account for the minimum instrumental-resolution peak width in the half-integer-L plotting comparison. It explicitly shows the zero-splitting model and reports an approximate 35 microeV splitting for the model with |J7a-J7b|=5 microeV. The card encodes only this additive comparison, not a physical convolution or the observed fitted width; its offset, two control values, readout definition, applicability, and anchors are source-supported. Approximate 35 microeV is used only as the printed central comparison value.

issues.detail: The additive 28 microeV operation is a plotting comparison for instrumental width, not a general resolution convolution; the card’s applicability and readout are restricted accordingly.

controls.definition: Calculated energy splitting between the two magnon bands used for comparison with the fitted Gaussian peak widths.
controls.name: calculated_altermagnetic_splitting

applicability.statement: This additive relation is the source's plotting comparison for half-integer-L peak broadening; the 28 microeV term represents the minimum width attributed to instrumental resolution.
The nonzero splitting value is approximate and corresponds to the source's model with exchange anisotropy |J7a-J7b|=5 microeV; zero denotes the explicitly shown zero-splitting comparison.

readouts.definition: Calculated magnon splitting after adding the minimum peak-width offset for comparison with fitted Gaussian peak widths.
readouts.name: resolution_broadened_peak_width
